battle.beasts.defeat.template: Beasts attacked {hex}: lost. Tribute {tribute}. Scorched until {until}.

battle.beasts.overrun.template: Beasts attacked {hex}: lost. Tribute {tribute}. {hex} returns to the wilds.

battle.mythic.defeat.template: Mythic attack on {hex}: lost. Tribute {tribute}. Scorched until {until}.

battle.mythic.overrun.template: Mythic attack on {hex}: lost. Tribute {tribute}. {hex} returns to the wilds.

battle.raid.defeat.template: {rival} raid on {hex}: lost. Tribute {tribute}. Scorched until {until}.

battle.conquest.contested.template: {rival} conquest attempt on {hex}: lost. Contested until {until}.

battle.conquest.broken.template: {rival} renewed its conquest attempt on {hex}: held. The attempt is broken.

battle.conquest.lost.template: {rival} renewed its conquest attempt on {hex}: lost. {hex} passes to {rival}.

battle.conquest.coreHeld.template: {rival} conquest attempt on {hex}: lost. The heartland cannot be taken, so the hex is scorched until {until}.

battle.assault.rout.template: Assault on {hex}: taken in a rout. Spoils {spoils}.

battle.assault.repulsed.template: Assault on {hex}: repulsed. Its garrison stays worn down until it falls, easing a little each day it is left alone.

battle.counterattack.victory.template: Counterattack on {hex}: held. The force that fell back is scattered. Spoils {spoils}.

battle.counterattack.rout.template: Counterattack on {hex}: routed. The force that fell back is scattered. Spoils {spoils}.

battle.counterattack.defeat.template: Counterattack on {hex}: lost. The hex goes back to those who held it. Tribute {tribute}.

battle.assault.breach.template: Assault on {hex}: repulsed, but its garrison is worn within reach. The same assault would take it.

battle.grandIllusion.template: Battle at {hex} lost. Grand Illusion: no tribute, and the hex is not contested.

battle.surge.defeat.template: Surge on {hex}: lost. The hex is scorched until {until}. Tribute {tribute}.
